title: Preparation and Reactivity of a Compartmental Schiff-Base Samarium Dinuclear Complex

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen (drybox or Schlenk), a stirred suspension of SmCl3(THF)3 (2.6 g, 5.5 mmol) in 100 mL of THF was treated with (3,5-But4salophen)Na2(THF)2 (4.0 g, 5.5 mmol). The resulting clear orange solution was stirred at room temperature for 16 h. The solvent was removed in vacuo, and the residual solid was dissolved in diethyl ether (120 mL). NaCl was filtered off, the filtrate was concentrated to 75 mL, and standing at room temperature for 2 days yielded light orange microcrystals of 1.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed in vacuo; residue dissolved in Et2O (120 mL); NaCl filtered; concentrated to 75 mL; standing at room temperature for 2 days gave light orange microcrystals

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, Method A: (3,5-But4salophen)Na2(THF)2 (2.5 g, 3.4 mmol) was added to a stirred solution of SmI2(THF)5 (1.9 g, 3.5 mmol) in THF (100 mL), rapidly forming a deep red solution. After stirring 1.5 h, solvent was removed in vacuo. The dark red residue was redissolved in toluene (100 mL), NaI was filtered off, and red needles of 2 separated on standing at room temperature for 2 days. X-ray-quality crystals were obtained by recrystallization from toluene. The paper also states that 2 can be prepared by reduction of 1 with metallic lithium in THF (Method B quantities are truncated in the converted Markdown).

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, complex 2 was treated with MeLi in THF (the converted Markdown truncates the opening reagent line). Addition in 100 mL of THF produced a color change from dark red to light brown. Stirring was continued for 24 h. Solvent was removed in vacuo and the residual deep yellow solid was dissolved in 75 mL of hexane. Filtration, concentration to 30 mL, and standing at room temperature for 7 days yielded yellow needles of 3. The reaction alkylates both Sm centers, cleaves the connecting C–C bond of 2, fully reduces the imine groups, and deoxygenates THF to give the μ-oxo dimer.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, a stirred toluene solution (50 mL) of 2 (1.0 g, 0.58 mmol) was exposed at room temperature to excess dry O2, becoming brown after 24 h. Yellow crystals of 4 (0.30 g, 0.095 mmol, 33%) separated upon standing at room temperature for 5 days. The product is a hydroxide (IR 3583–3585 cm−1) formed by cleavage of the connecting C–C bond of 2 and assembly of a Sm4(OH)4 cuboid.
